gui.comment_under_title.github: Crash Assistant has collected diagnostic information. First click “$LANG.gui.upload_all_comment$”. Then open a new Arcomua Modpack issue, paste the copied report, and describe what you were doing before the crash. Please also mention any mods, resource packs, shaders, or configuration files you changed.
gui.comment_under_title_cant_resolve.git: Still need help? Search the Arcomua Modpack issue tracker first. If no existing issue matches, create a new one and include the generated report.
gui.comment_under_title_pls_report.githu: To report this problem or ask for help, open the Arcomua Modpack issue tracker and include the generated report.
gui.upload_all_button: Upload diagnostic logs and copy report
gui.comment_under_title_screenshot_notic: Please send the generated report instead of only a screenshot. A screenshot of this window does not contain the logs needed to diagnose the crash.
gui.drag_drop_message:
1. Drag a single log entry, or “$LANG.gui.file_list_label$” to include all available logs.
2. Drop it into the GitHub issue.
